ns0:g.ns0:text: Pressure head is the hydraulic grade elevation minus local pipe elevation
Illustrative flowing-main head losses4 m per250 m reach; elevations and HGL are not a solved distribution model. Node pressure head excludes velocity
head; pressure p=ρg(HGL−z). Under no-flow conditions the connected HGL approaches tank surface head if no other imposed heads intervene. Minimum/maximum
